title: scrophularia nodosa var. lanceolata
intro: Scrophularia nodosa var. lanceolata, commonly known as a variant of the greater figwort plant, is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Scrophularia nodosa var. lanceolata are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which may contribute to its medicinal effects.
